source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Climbing vine up to about 10 m with long forked tendrils
morphology_documented.leaves: Usually 7 leaflets sometimes 5–6; individual leaflets usually 3–5(–6) × 2(–3) cm, relatively thick and fleshy, glossy above
morphology_documented.fruit: Berry about 1 cm diameter containing 1–4 seeds
morphology_documented.habitat: Climbs vegetation on rocky or sandy sites; Edwards Plateau and Lampasas Cut Plain

source_scope_note: Historical varieties and synonyms preserved by original names; measurements never automatically transferred to different modern taxon concepts.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora describes endemic Edwards Plateau/Lampasas Cut Plain concept; BONAP county-target record remains separate
Compared with P. quinquefolia: usually 7 small thick leaflets rather than 5–6 larger thinner ones
preservation: Additive source record; existing gallery, pictures, credits and species files unchanged
